snippets.snippet: SPRING BURNING SEASON It ’ s important to know that during the months of March, April and May outside burning is NOT PERMITTED from 6 am to 6 pm. This ban includes burning of yard waste, trash and debris, even in a proper burn barrel. However, you ARE permitted to burn during the evening hours of 6 pm to 6 am. Why is this, you ask?  Although we typically associate spring with rain, the trees, leaves and underbrush are typically extremely dry from the long, cold winter.  Relative humidity increases in the evening. With the absence of the sun, the moisture levels in the air increases, helping to reduce the chance of fire spread.  Winds die down in the evening. Although not always true, typically once the sun sets and the air temperature stabilizes, the winds die down as well, also reducing fire spread.  It ’ s dark and embers are easier to see. NILE TOWNSHIP AUXILIARY Community Members for Community Progress Gearing up for the new year! Last year was our first year opening the Nile Township Auxiliary and it has been set up to fit our community needs. The goal of the Auxiliary is to bring more events and togetherness for the Nile community families and children. We are always welcoming new members, male or female, that wish to be a part of this amazing auxiliary. We are looking for persons who are wanting to bring creative ideas to bring our community together. If you wish to be a part of the auxiliary, please come to one of our bi - weekly meetings. We would love to have you join us! Last year ’ s community opportunities were a hit!
